_comentario: Define la consulta de ventas de A3ERP (CABEFACV + LINEFACT, las mismas tablas que usa el cubo de Ventas del Power BI), el mapeo y el registro de empresas (cada empresa = su propia base de datos A3ERP). La consulta usa {base} para la base de la empresa y {RANGO} para el filtro de fechas. TIPODOC: 'Cargo' = factura emitida, 'Abono' = factura rectificativa.

sqlVentas.consulta: SELECT c.FECHA AS FECHA, c.SERIE AS SERIE, CAST(c.NUMDOC AS bigint) AS NRO_DOC, c.TIPODOC AS TIPO_DOC, LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODCLI)) AS COD_CLIENTE, c.NOMCLI AS NOMBRE_CLIENTE, LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODREP)) AS COD_COMERCIAL, rep.NOMREP AS NOMBRE_COMERCIAL, c.BASEMONEDA AS BASE_IMPONIBLE, c.TOTMONEDA AS TOTAL, ISNULL(c.TOTALSUPLIDOSMON,0) AS PORTES, c.TOTDTOMONEDA AS DESC_PIE, 0 AS RAPPEL, NULL AS NRO_ALBARAN, NULL AS NRO_ANULADA, LTRIM(RTRIM(l.CODART)) AS COD_ARTICULO, LTRIM(RTRIM(art.DESCART)) AS NOMBRE_ARTICULO, l.UNIDADES AS CANTIDAD, l.PRECIO AS PRECIO, l.PRCMEDIO AS COSTE_UNITARIO, l.DESC1 AS DESC_LINEA, l.BASEMONEDA AS BASE_LINEA FROM [{base}].dbo.CABEFACV c LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.LINEFACT l ON l.IDFACV = c.IDFACV AND l.ESCOMPONENTE = 'F' OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 r.NOMREP FROM [{base}].dbo.REPRESEN r WHERE r.CODREP = c.CODREP ORDER BY r.NOMREP) rep OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 a.DESCART FROM [{base}].dbo.ARTICULO a WHERE a.CODART = l.CODART ORDER BY a.DESCART) art {RANGO}
sqlVentas.filtroFecha: WHERE c.FECHA >= CONVERT(datetime, '{desde}', 120) AND c.FECHA <= CONVERT(datetime, '{hasta}', 120)

sqlMaestros.consulta:
SELECT 
  'SF' as EMPRESA_COD, 
  c.CODCLI, 
  LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CODCLI)) as COD_CLIENTE,
  o.NOMBRE as NOMBRE_CLIENTE,
  o.NOMFISCAL,
  o.DIR1, o.DIR2, o.POBLACION, o.MUNICIPIO, o.PROVIFISCAL, o.CODPROVI, o.CODPAIS, o.PAISFISCAL,
  o.TELEFONO, o.FAX, o.E_MAIL, o.CODREP, o.CODREP2, o.CODREP3,
  r.NOMREP as NOMBRE_COMERCIAL
FROM [{base}].dbo.__CLIENTES c
LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.__ORGANIZACION o ON o.IDORG = c.IDORG
LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.REPRESEN r ON r.CODREP = o.CODREP
 {RANGO}
sqlMaestros.consultaComerciales: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(r.CODREP)) AS COD_REP, r.NOMREP AS NOMBRE FROM [{base}].dbo.REPRESEN r

sqlArticulos.consulta: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(CODART)) AS COD_ARTICULO, DESCART AS NOMBRE_ARTICULO, PRCCOSTE, PRECIOBASE, REFART, CODBAR, PESO, VOLUMEN FROM [{base}].dbo.ARTICULO

sqlProveedores.consulta: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(p.CODPRO)) AS COD_PROVEEDOR, o.NOMBRE AS NOMBRE_PROVEEDOR, o.NOMFISCAL, o.NIF, o.DIR1, o.DIR2, o.POBLACION, o.PROVIFISCAL AS PROVINCIA, o.PAISFISCAL AS PAIS, o.TELEFONO, o.E_MAIL, p.PLAZOSUMINISTRO FROM [{base}].dbo.__PROVEED p LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.__ORGANIZACION o ON o.IDORG = p.IDORG

sqlStock.consulta:
SELECT
  LTRIM(RTRIM(A.CODART)) AS CODART,
  A.DESCART AS NOMBRE,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.CODALM)), ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(A.CODALM))) AS CODALM,
  COALESCE(M.DESCALM, '') AS NOMALM,
  COALESCE(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.LOTE)), '') AS LOTE,
  ISNULL(S.UNIDADESSTOCK, 0) AS UNIDADESSTOCK,
  S.PRCMEDIO,
  S.FECCADUC,
  COALESCE(S.UBICACION, '') AS UBICACION
FROM [{base}].dbo.ARTICULO A
LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.STOCKALM S ON S.CODART = A.CODART
LEFT JOIN [{base}].dbo.ALMACEN M
  ON M.CODALM = COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(S.CODALM)), ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(A.CODALM)))
